# PHP8.0 - an exception is displayed when creating a catalog price rule with a specific condition

Using PHP8.0, when we create a catalog price rule with a specific condition
An exception is displayed
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/16067358/160637215-4b375bd6-26fe-4551-8659-a791eeed4cb6.png)

## Étapes
1. Go to BO > Catalog > Discounts > Catalog price rule page
2. Create a catalog price rule with any discount
3. In the condition section, add Condition group 1 for the men category and add  Condition group 2 for the clothes category
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/16067358/160638089-31e8d24e-f224-48cd-b7f7-2ce202d22e86.png)
4. Save 
5. see error

ÉTAPE 1 LOCALISER. Réponds en JSON : {"keywords": ["...", "..."]} (3 à 8 mots-clés).
